316:**Eval result ingestion** (`/projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/...`) — how `@mcpjam/sdk` saves results from eval runs executed
outside the platform (local dev, CI). The `{projectId}` segment accepts the literal `default` for the key org's Default project. M
ost users never call these directly — set `MCPJAM_API_KEY` and the [SDK reporter](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/saving-resu
lts.md) does:
320:| `POST .../eval-ingest/report` | One-shot: create a run from finished results and finalize it |
321:| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/start` | Chunked flow: create (or idempotently reuse) a run by `externalRunId` |
322:| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/iterations` | Append an iteration batch to a started run |
323:| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/finalize` | Finalize a chunked run (idempotent) |
324:| `POST .../eval-ingest/artifacts` | Store one artifact's raw bytes (widget HTML too large to send inline) and return its `sto
rageId` |
325:| `POST .../eval-ingest/artifacts/upload-url` | Retired. Answers `410 Gone` with `details.code: "SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED"`. `@mcp
jam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload artifacts with `POST .../eval-ingest/artifacts` instead |
332:| `POST .../agent` | Run ONE assistant turn over a `messages` history (`{role: "user"\|"assistant", content}` items, max 50 me
ssages × 8 KB each, 96 KB total). The model is pinned server-side and billed to the project. The turn can read project servers/sui
tes/runs and **create eval suites**; it can NOT start runs — kick those off yourself with `POST .../eval-runs`. Responds synchrono
usly with `reply`, the `toolCalls` it made, `createdResources` (ids + app links), and token `usage`. Capped at 4 concurrent turns
per organization and \~90 s wall clock. **Not idempotent — never blind-retry**: dedupe on your own trigger identity, and on an err
or response check `details.createdResources` (and, after a lost response, list suites) before retrying, or you'll create duplicate
s |

568:| `POST /feedback` | Send a bug report, missing-capability note, or other feedback to the MCPJam team. Body: `{ kind, summary,
details?, operation?, requestId?, errorCode?, projectId? }`. Responds `201 { id, receivedAt, duplicate }` once stored. Signed-in
accounts only (guests get `401`). Rate-limited per user (`429` with `Retry-After`). Accepts `Idempotency-Key` (validated strictly
— an empty or over-long key is `400`, not silently ignored; the same key with different content is `409`). **The text goes to the
MCPJam team, outside your organization, and is kept for 180 days.** |
